bar_share.note: the acceptance bar: share of pixels whose worst channel is >8 levels off, worst frame of a spread sample

bar_peak.note: the peak bar; NOT the 8-level threshold that defines a bad pixel

gate_ratio.note: the int8 ceiling with a scalar epilogue - a speedup, so never a share

kill_prob.note: P(pass) below this and the lane is not worth its probe

zero_excess.note: a margin bar: the excess must be at or below zero

bar_slope_span.note: beyond +-2 the PReLU is no longer a leaky rectifier

bar_block_time.note: the probe's own acceptance: a 64->64 block at 2.07 Mpx including the per-channel epilogue

bar_int8_window.note: accepted: the model window against fp16 in the SAME session, >=1.4x

bar_int8_wall.note: accepted: wall clock under the gate on a long clip

bar_int8_share.note: the quality gate: worst frame of a spread sample, worst channel >8 levels

bar_int8_peak.note: PENDING OWNER DECISION: 20 is the project's existing peak bar; 23 is the tile-reuse opt-in's peak, not an int8 number
